protocol.name: ext_data_control_v1
protocol.description:
This protocol allows a privileged client to control data devices. In particular, the client will be able to manage the current selection and take the role of a clipboard manager.
This protocol is a stable analog of the unstable zwlr_data_control_v1 protocol.

interface.name: ext_data_control_manager_v1
interface.description: This interface is a manager that allows creating per-seat data device controls.

request.name: get_data_device

description.summary: get a data device for a seat

request.description: Creates a data device that can be used to manage a seat's selection.

request.name: destroy
request.description: All objects created by the manager will still remain valid, until their appropriate destroy request has been called.

interface.name: ext_data_control_device_v1
interface.description: This interface allows a client to manage a seat's selection.

request.name: set_selection
request.description:
This request asks the compositor to set the selection to the data from the source on behalf of the client.
To unset the selection, set the source to NULL.

event.name: data_offer
event.description: The data_offer event introduces a new ext_data_control_offer object, which will subsequently be used in either the ext_data_control_device.selection event (for the regular clipboard selections) or the ext_data_control_device.primary_selection event (for the primary clipboard selections).

event.name: selection
event.description: The selection event is sent out to notify the client of a new ext_data_control_offer for the selection of this device.

event.name: finished

description.summary: this data control is no longer valid

event.description: This data control object is no longer valid and should be destroyed.

event.name: primary_selection
event.description: The primary_selection event is sent out to notify the client of a new ext_data_control_offer for the primary selection of this device.

request.name: set_primary_selection

description.summary: copy data to the primary selection

request.description:
This request asks the compositor to set the primary selection to the data from the source on behalf of the client.
To unset the primary selection, set the source to NULL.

interface.name: ext_data_control_source_v1
interface.description: The ext_data_control_source_v1 object is the source side of a ext_data_control_offer.

request.name: offer
request.description: This request adds a MIME type to the set of MIME types advertised to targets.

arg.name: mime_type
arg.summary: MIME type offered by the data source

event.name: send
event.description: Request for data from the client. Send the data as the specified MIME type over the passed file descriptor, then close it.

event.name: cancelled
event.description: This data source is no longer valid. The client should clean up and destroy this data source.

interface.name: ext_data_control_offer_v1
interface.description: An ext_data_control_offer_v1 represents a piece of data offered for transfer by another client (the source client).

request.name: receive

description.summary: request that the data is transferred

request.description: To transfer the offered data, the client issues this request and indicates the MIME type it wants to receive. The transfer happens through the passed file descriptor.

event.name: offer
event.description: Sent immediately after creating the ext_data_control_offer object. One event per offered MIME type.
